_source: Extracted + genericized from the reference design's About page product-specific FAQ set (some_styles/canehouse/priority) - an alternate/second FAQ set distinct from the existing generic faqs.json (general business questions); this set focuses on product-specific questions.
title: Common Questions

items.question: Is it made fresh daily?
items.answer: Yes, everything is prepared fresh, in small batches, every day.

items.question: Are there any added preservatives?
items.answer: No, we use only natural ingredients with nothing artificial added.

items.question: How should it be stored?
items.answer: Best enjoyed fresh; refrigerate and consume within 24 hours if not consumed immediately.

items.question: Is it suitable for kids?
items.answer: Yes, it's a family-friendly treat enjoyed by all ages.
